Welcome to my personal website! I'm Varun Vaidhiya, a Software Engineer and Solution Architect building the intelligence layer for AI and physical AI — full-stack robotic software, autonomous vehicles, and edge AI.

I'll be sharing thoughts on:
Full-stack robotic software — perception, VLA inference, agent reasoning, fleet management, and safety certification
Autonomous vehicles — sensor fusion, perception models, model-based safety design
AI & physical AI — the intelligence layer between AI models and physical robots
Open source projects I'm building and shipping, including OhhO Robotics

Everything I build lands on GitHub — feel free to fork, remix, or contribute.

Here's a collection of projects I've been building. All code is open source on GitHub.

The intelligence layer for AI and physical AI

A full-stack open-source robotics platform covering the complete robot lifecycle under one engine. 19 product consoles span design (3D robot builder), training (VLA/BC/RL fine-tuning), simulation (Gazebo/Isaac Sim), serving (REST inference API), agent reasoning (perceive → reason → verify → act → monitor → reflect), fleet management (OTA, monitoring), and safety certification (ISO 10218, ISO 13849, IEC 61508). Built on OhhO OS — a single open-source engine (Apache-2.0) that's robot-agnostic, brand-agnostic, and standards-based. The reference robot is a ~$500 mecanum mobile manipulator with a 6-camera array and a unified 9D learned policy (SmolVLA).

chunks.text:
Hi, I'm Varun Vaidhiya — a Perception Engineer and Solution Architect specialising in 3D spatial intelligence and embodied AI. I unify 3D geometry with semantic scene understanding for robot navigation, locomotion, and manipulation. 
 I've architected end-to-end perception stacks — multi-camera bird's-eye-view perception, RGB-D 3D SLAM with persistent 3D occupancy mapping, 6-DoF object pose estimation, and EKF multi-sensor fusion. I train and deploy multimodal Vision-Language-Action networks in PyTorch and optimise them for ultra-low-latency edge GPU inference via TensorRT and ONNX Runtime. 
 I'm currently building OhhO Robotics , a full-stack open-source robotics platform covering the complete robot lifecycle under one engine. I'm targeting Solution Architect and Forward-Deployed Engineer roles in robotics and autonomous vehicles — companies building the intelligence layer for AI and physical AI.
chunks.title: About

chunks.text:
Oct 2024 – Present

Founded OhhO Robotics and built a full-stack robotics operating platform (25K+ lines, ROS 2 Jazzy) spanning perception, VLA inference, teleoperation, simulation, data pipelines, and fleet operations — productising a full embodied-AI stack from research prototype to deployable software.
chunks.title: About
chunks.heading: OhhO Robotics — Founder & Perception / Robotics Software Engineer

chunks.text:
Built multi-camera bird's-eye-view perception (4 wide-angle feeds → unified top-down via per-camera homographies with RANSAC/checkerboard calibration, CPU-only at 30 Hz)
Engineered persistent 3D spatial mapping fusing RGB-D 3D SLAM (RTAB-Map) and 3D occupancy mapping (OctoMap) with wheel-odometry/IMU EKF state estimation
Trained and fine-tuned multimodal Vision-Language-Action networks (SmolVLA, OpenVLA) in PyTorch, served behind a REST API (pluggable backends, Prometheus metrics)
Optimised perception and policy inference for edge hardware via TensorRT FP16/INT8 and ONNX Runtime (2–3x vision-encoder speed-up, under 5% output deviation, sub-200 ms end-to-end latency)
Built an end-to-end demonstration-data pipeline (LeRobot v2.0 format) with distributed training and W&B experiment tracking

Dec 2023 – Oct 2024
chunks.title: About
chunks.heading: OhhO Robotics — Founder & Perception / Robotics Software Engineer

chunks.text:
Fine-tuned SAM 2 on autonomous driving datasets (Cityscapes) using distributed training, systematic hyperparameter optimisation, and W&B experiment tracking
Benchmarking vision foundation models on embedded platforms (Jetson Orin, RTX mobile GPU) — inference latency, memory footprint, and model performance
Optimised deep learning inference pipelines using Nsight Systems/Compute; applied INT8/FP16 quantisation, TensorRT optimisation, and custom CUDA kernels (30% inference time reduction on RTX 4070 mobile)
Investigated model compression (knowledge distillation, quantisation-aware fine-tuning, pruning) for deploying large-scale transformers on resource-constrained edge hardware

Mar 2023 – Jul 2023
